caption: The drawing consists of two main sections on a plain background. In the upper section, there is an oval-shaped illustration bordered by a pattern of red, white, and green dots and curves on a black background. Inside the oval, there is a single human figure dressed in a green hat with a feather, a reddish-orange long coat, yellowish undershirt, green knee-length pants, green stockings, and brown shoes. The figure is standing sideways and touching a tall, thin, plant-like object with small leaves, which is positioned to the left of the figure. The lower section of the drawing displays a rectangular fragment with a floral motif, also set on a black background. The floral design features a large flower in red and off-white with green and yellow leaves radiating outward. Both sections use a similar color palette dominated by earthy tones of red, green, and yellow on a dark background.
title: Pa. German Band Box
